note: Faithful synthetic IPC stub for Vite renderer preview-state capture ONLY. Not native IPC/hardware proof. Every renderer screenshot taken with this stub is simulated.

scan_devices.comment: Non-blocking start; returns Running immediately (scan.rs start_scan). Capture never clicks Scan; stub exists so a click would resync instead of throwing.

get_scan_state.comment: Initial sync (ScanControls mount). Idle/0 repairs the previous 'Could not read the current scan state' capture artifact — the genuine error DOM stays in production code.

cancel_scan.comment: Idempotent cancel; resolves void (undefined over IPC becomes null in JSON transport).

open_report.comment: Native open dialog; null = user cancelled (normal, not an error). Capture loads the bundled fictional sample directly, never through this stub.

export_report.comment: Native save dialog; null = user cancelled. Full export = zero args; filtered = exactly the id list (validated Rust-side).

export_html_report.comment: Native save dialog for the renderer-built HTML; null = user cancelled. Empty/oversized refused Rust-side before the dialog.

get_report.comment: Read-only current-report slot; null = none yet. Sample loads via the bundled JSON validator, not via an invented report here.

get_notebook.comment: Read-only notebook view (camelCase updatedAt); empty = no scan has recorded anything yet.

save_device_note.comment: Notebook write; key must exist Rust-side (unknown_key), text capped at 4000 chars.
